symptom: ako/mxcli#888 (rehearsal 2 G1): under `mdl 1`, `create or modify microflow|nanoflow` that grows a stored flow by a guard clause (`if … then return …; end if;` before what it had — the stub-then-real pattern) was refused on every run: "insert before return false: the fragment returns; a return inside an inserted fragment is not supported yet". A changed `if` condition was refused too: "cannot replace the ExclusiveSplit … only an activity or a loop can be". mdl 0 rebuilt the whole flow (MDL-V1-REBUILD).
cause: cutFragment (cmd_alter_flow.go) cut the builder's graph only when it had exactly one end event, the one the body falls through to; a guard's return draws a second. The diff matched an `if` only when its condition was the same (sameIfShell), so a changed condition became a replace of the decision, which the mutator refuses (a decision's paths would be taken out).
fix: The builder records which end events RETURN statements drew (flowBuilder.returnEndIDs) and which one the body falls through to (fallThroughEndID); cutFragment cuts only the fall-through end and keeps return ends as new end events of the flow, refusing any other end (an error handler ended at the fragment's end). fragmentBox.checkRoom also runs checkBranches: a return's branch area (decision side to end event) crossed by a stored flow's centre-to-centre line is refused. A changed `if` condition is paired in the LCS (sameBlockShell via ifConditionChanged) and becomes an AlterFlowOperation with SetCondition, applied by the new MicroflowMutator.SetCondition (expression + caption in place; a derived caption follows the condition, an explicit one is kept; a rule decision is refused; scope-checked). MCP mutator refuses SetCondition like SetReturnValue. Two defects the grow exposed: a fragment whose exit is the guard's decision dropped the false path's case value (cutFragment discarded the fall-through flow; spliceOnFlow/Replace wrote the flow out with NoCase -> mx check CE0079 + CE0773); MicroflowFragment.ExitCase now carries it (new flow, or setCase on the stored out flow for Replace). And withImplicitEnd ran before canonicalFlow, so a guard directly before the final end (described as if/else with returns) was compared against a declared body without its trailing return: second run refused 'the Return … is taken out'; it now runs after canonicalFlow.
test: mdl/roundtrip/flow_splice_guard_test.go TestSpliceRerun_GrowByGuard (mxcli-authored stub, twice-exec + description fixed point + condition control), TestSpliceRerun_GrowStudioProFlowByGuard (PedApp ShowPasswordForm), TestSpliceRerun_GrowByGuardAcrossAFlowIsRefused (+ free-room control), TestSpliceRerun_StudioProDecisionConditionSetInPlace (PedApp ChangePassword, caption kept); mdl/backend/mfmutator/splice_guard_test.go. Revert checks: cutFragment refusing return ends -> all grow tests fail with the refusal; SetCondition unset -> 'cannot replace the ExclusiveSplit'; checkBranches disabled -> the crossing is written. mx check clean on the TestApp repro copy. TestSpliceRerun_ReplaceEndingInGuard and the Studio Pro grow assert every decision out-flow has a case (requireDecisionCases); reverting ExitCase -> 'no case value (CE0079)'. TestSpliceRerun_GuardBeforeTheFinalEnd; reverting the order -> 'the Return at (865, 200) is taken out'. TestApp copy: grow, rerun, condition change, Studio Pro PopulateUserAttributes guard, replace-ending-in-guard: mx check 0 errors (before the ExitCase fix: CE0079 + CE0773).
insight: The builder knows which end events are returns and which is its own fall-through end; the cut must ask it, not count end events. A script that states the @position of stored nodes and inserts before them is not a fixed point (the insert shifts them, the second run moves them back) — a general splice property, not specific to returns; test twice-exec with layout-free scripts and with the fresh description. mx check on a Studio Pro flow found the CE0079 the PedApp tests passed over: assert decision case values in BSON, never trust describe to show a missing case.
